commit.message:
[dvsim] Load the Verdi FSDB dumper for Xcelium

Dumping FSDB waves with Xcelium (`-w fsdb`) needs Verdi's FSDB dumper
loaded into the simulator. Nothing loaded it, so waves.tcl failed with
`*E,CFCNOF: Task or function name "fsdbDumpfile" not found` and no
waves were dumped.

When the wave format is fsdb, pass the dumper PLI (`-loadpli1
.../debpli.so:novas_pli_boot`) to the build and run, and its CFC library
(`-loadcfc .../debcfc.so:novas_cfc_boot`) to the run, since the latter
provides the `call fsdb*` Tcl commands waves.tcl uses. Both depend on
libIUS.so in the same directory and have no rpath, so also prepend that
directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Other wave formats (e.g. shm) are
unaffected and keep working without Verdi.

Fixes #31726.
